01_bm25.text: Separate 2020 from 2021 model reviews please!. The 2021 model is a downgrade from the 2020 Moto G Power. (Do just a little homework & you'll read why.) Amazon should not be lumping their reviews together, as they have different specs and this is misleading to customers reading the reviews. I am pleased with my 2020 model Moto G Power. I feel it's a good value and quality for the money. Particularly pleased with the storage space. If you play games with any graphics intensity at all, know that the 3-day battery claim will not apply. I found that to be a disappointment, given how much battery life is hyped for the Moto G Power. I really only get a full day, maybe, out of the battery if I game a lot that day. If I hardly game at all, I think I get maybe a day & a half to 2 days, at a stretch.

Awesome Moto G Fast with Android v10. Upgraded from the Moto G5 Plus to the Moto G Fast (just out in June 2020). Overall, a solid phone with a modern OS, that won't disappoint.
Moto G Power 2020. Great phone! I love the long battery life. So many features and I have yet to use the facial recognition.

I Really Like This Phone. I ended up choosing this one because of the more powerful camera. I really love it and I am very happy with my purchase.

Direct-to-ear call quality is as it should be but I avoid that so for me, the speakerphone is going to remain a real trade-off. But that’s the only drawback to the Moto G Stylus 2020, or perhaps just to phones with stereos speakers. In all other ways I’m finding the 2020 Moto G Stylus to be a mega value for anywhere near its price range.

This is really a great phone for the price.. I love my moto g power 2020. The speakers are loud. I actually have to turn it down. It is really fast, I play games on it , it doesn't crash and it loads fast. The battery life is great. I don't have to charge my phone every day. I charge my phone every 3 or 4 days.

A great budget phone, but the G Fast is still a better buy. This phone suits my needs. It has a nice matte finish, and it even gets though my tasks well. I give this device a good point for it's battery. However, the Moto G Fast, despite being a 2020 model, is still a better device in it's specs, so if you want those, get that instead. a reliable brand. Last October I purchased the 2020 Moto G Power for a friend. She had previously owned a Moto G5+ and after three years, the micro charge connection on that workhorse was weakening. I went on the Amazon to put a study on the latest from Motorola Android One unlocked. I read the reviews and specs on the 2020 G Power . The upgrade to the more robust type C charging port was noted. I ordered the 2020 Moto G Power and had it shipped to an Amazon drop where it arrived quickly and while my friend's old phone was still functional. The clerks at the facility helped her move the SIM card over, and transfer photos and files onto the new device. After restoring the navigation buttons, she became comfortable with the new phone. I've owned two Motorola phones myself and have recommended them to friends and family.

Excellent phone fast and it does the Job.. I bought the Moto G to replace my Samsung a20. the Moto G is fast and it does the Job, the battery life is good but not as advertised. if you are debating between the a20 and the Moto G get the Moto G is way better built on the screen dept. Also I only used the phone for calls and some text messages and it works fine.
Moto g 2020. This phone is adequate at best. I needed a phone and upon recommendation, ordered this one, however it barely compares to my Samsung Galaxy, but for the price it will have to do.

Love This Phone (G power 2020). Went from a Essential Phone to the G Power. This phone can't be beat for the price. The battery life is wonderful (when screen brightness is not up). Some lag occasionally but overall fast response. Perfect phone if you aren't heavy into mobile gaming.

Can't go wrong with Motorola. I'm a relatively unpicky, average smart phone user who replaces their phone after 2-4 years (as needed by ever-growing app sizes and demands for processing power) but I don't need THE best phone out there. Right now (summer 2020) the Moto G Power is a "better" phone according to all of the nit-picky tech reviews, but only because it has slightly more internal storage and longer battery life (that's about the only real difference between the two! Overall opinion: This Motorola G Fast is, refreshingly, THE BEST smart phone I've ever had, after about 15 years of using smart phones. I forgot just how solid Motorola is, as a brand. They made the first cell phone, so they know what they're doing!
Moto G Fast. Very complete product

Moto g power battery life insane and very smooth -value king-. Pros: battery life, its fast, its smooth, very easy to use, light, fast Cons: camera is okay

Moto G Fast is Great!. This Moto G Fast is really a great phone! Awesome batter life... I use it as a phone (not as an entertainment or streaming device ). I can have the phone for 3-4 days without charging! Awesome. Features are fantastic, and it's fast. The quality of the phone is also great!. Went from Pixel 4XL to Moto G Stylus (2020). I am impressed. My pixel 4XL broke due to rapidly discharging battery (warranty is covering it) and I ended up buying a Moto g stylus (2020) last week for $199. I was blown away by the minimal difference in real world usage between this phone and the pixel 4XL. I use my phone quite a bit for texting, browsing, photos, and light gaming. I don't use NFC features. So with that out of the way, I can accurately say that I really have been paying too much for features/ specs that I don't really see much of a difference in when it comes to real world usage. I think I was getting too worked up on things reviewers would say or bring up that really didn't matter to me, yet somehow I worried it would be a problem.

Four--5 days on a charge!. There is a reason why the 2020 (NOT 2021) version of the Moto G-Power mobile phone was ranked by a prominent tech review company as the best bargain for a phone in the under $500 range. The same company slammed the 2021 version because it actually downgraded some components (do your research and grab a 2020 while you can). The battery life is fantastic, the 6.4" screen is very good, it comes with Android 10, but updates to Android 11 within one week of activation. It's processor is quick, and the cameras are respectable. If you want higher quality pictures, there are more expensive choices. For the average Joe or Jane, this G-Power provides the most bang for the buck.

Great Phone!. I bought this and it was delivered October 7, 2020. It has been a great phone so far. I had a Samsung S7 edge when I bought this Moto g power. I looked into getting the s9, but they are way too expensive. So, I started looking for a more affordable, but newer phone. I came across the Moto g power, checked out the reviews and decided to get it. I love it. I haven't had any problems with it at all. The problem I had was with straight talk customer service. It took me hours to get the phone transferred, but I'll save that for another review. 2 things I miss from my Samsung: LED Notification light Options for different fonts These aren't "deal breakers", but I do miss them. All in all, I would definitely purchase the Motorola g power again.

Honestly, whenever is fine with me. I grabbed this phone after I learned Moto was updating the G Power with a 2021 version, and that the new version had poorer specs than the 2020 model. Better than my last very expensive phone by a mile!!.... First I would like to point out that most of these reviews are talking about the 2020 version, not the 2021. I would recommend getting the 2020 version over the 2021... The 2020 is rated to be a better phone. I'm sure the 2021 is fine, but I had it first and it had a cheap feel to it so I mailed it back. I love the 2020 Moto g Power! I've had this phone now (2020 Version) for several months and I absolutely love it! Performance-wise I see no difference between this and my last very expensive phone that died... As long as you don't need NFC (pay at the store by waving your phone, which I rarely do anyway) this phone is for you! At $185 bucks you cannot go wrong with this phone... It's Absolutely marvelous then I can get a phone it's great for so cheap!

The phone is weighty and feels much like a premium flagship phone. The Moto G Power 2020 is practically the same size and weight of the Samsung S20 FE that I was considering at a fraction of the cost. It's speedy Snapdragon processor makes screen scrolling and streaming very smooth. The phone has very pleasing sounding stereo speakers and a large long lasting battery. The cameras on the Moto G Power 2020 take sharp looking colorful daytime snapshots however since the phone has no night scene mode photos taken at night or in the dark are poor compared to more expensive phones. Overall this is a great phone at a great price.

What I wanted. I previously had the 2020 moto g stylus through Verizon but I accidentally dropped it in a bucket of water and I wanted to replace it because of the dual speakers. I got one through Amazon a couple weeks ago and the replacement is better because it's unlocked.

Great phone experience, no NFC. I'm super happy with my 2020 Moto G Power. The stereo speakers are good. Battery life is fantastic. I'm running a custom ROM with zero bloatware. For the sale price here on amazon for this 2020 phone with android 10 I couldn't pass it up and so far I am glad I didn't. Good phone, but the screen glass is extremely fragile.. I upgraded from a Moto G5 plus to the Moto G power. The phone is larger, and the battery lasts longer. These are distinct pros. The one huge con is that the glass on the moto G5 plus was basically indestructible. I had it from its launch until june of 2020. Meaning I had it and used it every day for years. Including dropping it many times. The glass on the moto G5 Plus was very strong and never cracked or broke. My moto G power screen just shattered 3 spots from a 20 inch fall out of a chair. The glass is very fragile. It's very disappointing to have a 1 month old phone with a spider webbed screen. I will likely have this phone for the next 3-4 years so I'm sure the screen will just continue to break even more.

Overall an awesome phone. This phone looks nice and has a huge screen. It follows through with it's promise of going two days of moderate use on one charge. The reason for one less star is the speaker. The only output is at the bottom of the phone near the charging port, however when it's not accidentally covered it does project sound well. Overall I think the phone is awesome and I have no regrets. Side note: make sure the case is specifically made for a Moto G Fast and not the Moto g power model. Some people were saying that the cases for Moto g power would fit the Moto g fast and I found out that is not true. (Had to send a case back)

Moto G Power. Fantastic value!. I gave this as a gift so I didn't get to play with it too much. I did do all of the updates and charged to phone. Phone looks Nice and has a great screen. I would definitely own this phone. Unbelievable value for the money. Paid $179 brand new here on Amazon December 2020.

Love this phone!. Got it for less than $200. Some rank the Moto G power ahead of this phone because the battery lasts 3 days. But the Moto G Stylus battery lasts 2 days and it has more storage, a better camera, and a stylus! I will take that trade-off anyday.

I myself always buy the Flagship level phones, and this one has made me think twice about spending all that money. This budget level phone is very impressive, it runs Android 10 currently, is a 2020 model, and the battery life is amazing. Met all Expectations. I spent months reviewing the phones i thought were solid choices before deciding on the 2020 Moto G power. The first thing i was looking for was 64 GB of storage and unlocked for use in the USA and that supports VOLTE calling. Then i was looking at size, i previously had the LG stylo 6 which is huge and cumbersome for someone with little hands and the stylo itself had fallen out of the bottom of the phone within the first week i had it. So no stylo was desired... i wanted a solid battery, decent sound and good pictures. My last prerequisite was it had to have good reviews. This phone meets all of my needs and is 6.5 inches instead of 7 like the stylo 6.

Great phone. This is my replacement for my 2019 Moto G 7. The battery life on this phone is amazing. It's user friendly and the stylus is easy to get to. It's my first phone with a stylus. It's a fast phone and meets all my needs and so far meets all my expectations.

Love these phones. I've bought 2 Moto G Power's. One for me, this one for my sister. Both very happy with them. Biggest positives: Long battery life. Camera's are great. Supports a MicroSD chip, so transferring data was a snap. Screen is 1080p. Note: Get this 2020 model as long as possible. 2021 (& I think 2022) model is downgraded - e.g. slower CPU, poorer camera, coarser screen (720p?). Note: I don't use the face recognition or the fingerprint reader, so I can't say if they're any good.

Kinda clunky and slow. One year ago I accidently killed my 2020 g-fast and decided to get a newer phone. This one just isn't as nimble as the old one. It takes a long time to load sites, often timing out. I've kept it updated and pretty much use it for mail, texting, and news so my use isn't high-impact. As I'm writing this it's hiccuping and stalling out. G-fast was way better, alas.

Great Moto G phone. I think this may be the fourth Moto G phone I have owned. Before I bought my Moto G6 phone a few years ago, I thoroughly researched the other brands and kept coming back to the Moto G. This particular model is a great phone. The battery life is great, definitely 3 days worth. The fact that it is a large battery is a definite plus: everything loads more quickly. The photos are nice and crisp, better than the Moto G6. I highly recommend this phone if you are looking for something that is not too pricey and still does everything you want.

It works. I received my Motorola moto G power on June 4, 2020. First, I cleaned up my apps on my old phone and made sure the apps were in my Google apps library. Second, I cleaned up my data and made sure I backed it up on my computer or Google drive or google photos. Third, I formatted my SD card, for a clean install. Fourth, I took out the SD card and TMobile SIM card and installed it in the moto G power. Fifth, I put the Poetic Guardian 360 case on the moto G power. Sixth, I turned it on and set it up. Seven, it works. I am coming from a Samsung S8 Active that is my favorite phone. However, I cannot update an ATT phone over TMobile. Either way, I looked for the best phone at 200 dollars. It was the moto g7 power.
Very pleased with the Moto G. It takes a little getting used to but makes up of any negatives with an AWESOME battery life.

Moto G is still a great value!. I've been using Moto G phones since the first one came out. They still represent solid value, especially now that lower end phones have a higher baseline for hardware (eg, processors, cameras, etc) for everyday use. Why spend so much more on a "flagship" when you can get through the day with something like the Moto G Stylus? It's plenty fast for my needs, screen looks good (though no Gorilla Glass, so a screen protector/case may be wise), no bloat on the OS. What little Moto does add to the OS (eg, gestures) is actually very useful. I use the chop flashlight all the time. Fingerprint sensor works great, phone sounds good, and people can hear me just fine. Battery life so far is crazy good (maybe only beat by the Moto G Power).
moto g power. Love this phone size of screen-ease of use-fast-lots of battery power- at least 2 and a half days--great product-64 gb internal and has micro sd card-buy it you will not be disappointed

Saw a tech review like no buttons was a big deal, ha what a joke. And, the price is perfect to have a stylus pen also. Buy one you will not regret it. I haven't.
All day battery.. Fantastic battery life. My boy uses it all day and had 70% battery left.
Battery be like what?!. Battery Good. 2 days plus easy, minimal use.
The battery is outstanding. Very reliable smartphone. The battery is outstanding. It is better last more than my Samsung S10 Plus!
Great battery life. Battery life is amazing
Motorola wants $25 to swap phone. I will buy a new phone, not made by Chinese owners of Motorola name, then sell this Moto G Power phone.
The battery lasts longer than most.. Works as it should.

Battery Life Fading After Two Years, But Still Strong. This is my second Motorola cell phone and I've had it a little over two years. Never got 3 days out of the battery, but two was easy. It has slipped a little in the last year, so a day and a half about evenly split with two days. Depends on use and what programs I leave lurking in the background. Very happy with this base-level phone. I will seriously consider Motorola for my next phone although reviews of the current year's models are "iffy".
Fantastic battery life. Works great. battery life is the best feature.

Works Well. I bought the 2020 model for the better features. It seems like all the phone companies are down scalling features to reduce cost. I read many reviews which commented on the battery life. I've been using the phone for a month and have had the battery last for about 3 days as I tested that feature. I think I'm a normal phone user and do not watch videos or stream much. The only drain on the battery seems to be the GPS which is normal. I remove as much bloat wear as possible to reduce any unwanted overhead. The camera works fine for me but I don't have high demands for this feature. I hate that just about all phones have sealed batteries so they can advertize better water resistant features. My old phone, a G5 Plus required the entire motherboard be disassembled to change the battery.
long battery life. One charge lasts 2 days+ for my use. It's worth the price.

BATTERY NOT WHAT I EXPECTED!. I got this phone because of the battery reviews but half way through the day by 3pm on a fully charged battery it was already at 30% I REALLY DOUBT IT WOULD LAST 23 HRS OF MOVIES SMH
It has a great battery. It was my first time using Android that worked really well for me. But the prime is the battery that stands for 3 days easily.

OMG was I wrong..... Below was my initial review when I got it. I will explain after it but I found out I was wrong, much. "Battery lasts about 8 hours tops, then I need to use it charging cable connected in the car, fighting not to have it completely drained and die while delivering stuff." I am a UberEats driver, so when I got this phone, I immediately started to use it for UberEats delivery jobs. My thinking was, the previous phone - Moto G7 Power - was draining battery so quickly, I need something that holds juice a little bit better before I have to charge it.
Good phone and excellent value. Some reviews complain about battery life but I have not experienced that. I especially appreciate its Bluetooth range.

I LOVE THIS PHONE. I don't understand the bad reviews for this phone. I just purchased this 2/2021 and I think it is fantastic! I'm a 66 year old female and had no problem setting this phone up. Love the very loud speaker it has on it. I will update this review in a few months if I start having any issues. The battery life is not as good as some other phone I have had, but charges in about 20 minutes 0-100%, so no issue. I'm not a gamer, and the battery might be an issue for people who do that.
Great Phone. I love this phone. Didn't purchase from Amazon but I was inclined to write a review. Great camera and battery life! Fast with a great amount of storage!

Battery for days (literally)!. If I could give the battery life 6 stars I would. It will legitimately last me 3 days. Everything else is fine, no issues but I liked the fingerprint reader better on the side like my last Motorola.
Battery last for 3 days!!!. I like it a lot so far! Battery holds at least 3 days! So far so good!

Great phone. I waited to review to check everything out. I wasn't disappointed in anything. Battery life is just what they said it would be. All the newest features. Great sound. All around great phone.
But my phone battery has lasted me an average of 4 to 5 days between charges. I love the fingerprint on the back for any money transactions. I love my phone!

Wrong Advertisement, NOT A USAGE REVIEW. This is not a usage review, I will update my review about usage. The phone is scratched all over. Too many cosmetic damages. I wouldn't mind if you have been cleared about the problem. It looks like a really old phone. Any cosmetic damages on any used product should be listed or pictures posted otherwise you are saying the product has no damage cosmetic. If the phone was renewed how come almost half of the storage space is used? I am really dissatisfied with this product now especially with the seller. The phone is also very bad on battery. I fully changed the phone and turned it off for a day and a half, when I turned it back on the battery had gone down to 77%.

Battery Life Will Impress You. For a phone in this price range (and frankly above it), the battery life is really good. I bought this for my wife who uses a phone like a real person, not like a magazine reviewer. The battery lasts her all day, even as she has 14 different apps open running notifications and location services, browsing Facebook and playing games. A full charge with heavy use is enough to get you through a day, down to about 20% from using it between 6 a.m. - 11 p.m. at regular intervals. Set up was easy on Straight Talk with AT&T sim, I just put the card in and everything worked right out of the box. It's got a reasonable amount of storage for apps. My wife installs tons of stuff so this was a big plus for her.

Battery only lasts 9 hours when brand new.. I had a Motorola Z3 play. The radios stopped working in it. I'm sure it's from planned obsolescence. So... I bought this one. So far it works. They lie to you when they say it's a 3 day battery. 9 hours at best. So... I'll use it for a year then I'll be forced to buy another one as I'm sure it will quit working just after the warranty expires.

Moto G Power has excellent battery life. The battery life is so good, a few times I've tested it and got 3 days on 1 charge. Size if perfect, not too big or small. The Volume button and Power button are a little close.
Great phone highly recommend. Amazing phone, lots of ram and tons of storage, stylus adds to the cool factor of the phone. Battery life is also amazing, writing this review on it actually.

Freezes all the time!. After three months of use, it freezes very often at simple swipes while using an app or for example now when typing a review. Or just at start when you want to open an app and the phone is absolutely nonresponsive. A restart doesn't help, at least not for.long. Battery life is good. It froze twice while I've been typing this review. Do not buy if you want a phone that you can use normally as if we were in 2020.
The battery life lasts around 30hours with intensive use. A little heavy

Not what they say it is.. The phone does not last 24 hrs. 8/21/2020 I turned the phone on at around 6 am ,the battery was at 17% at 7 pm. The phone is brand new,so they say... I read the reviews before i bought it,I think maybe the reviews are from the seller or Manufacturer. I've had the phone for a couple of days and the phone battery life is bunk. Maybe this phone has been used before and resold to me,who knows. I will be returning. The phone only lasted 13 hours on a 100% full charge. 'So where do they get 3 days at' ?. The price should be a 100.00 bucks.

I am impressed!!!!. The 4000 mAh battery is beyond comparison IN MY OPINION! Despite what the mfr. tells you, I can take it off the charge on a Friday morning, use it continuously for the weekend and still have 29 percent remaining come Sunday night! The battery is lasting me about three days with heavy usage and about four, maybe five with light usage. I'm not used to that after having only 3000 mAh batteries! I also like that the 4000 mAh is lighter and smaller than a 5000 mAh battery. So I think its a huge plus all around. The stylus works perfectly and notes are no problem at all. Not sure why most reviews say they aren't. The display is phenomenal! Audio is exceptional. The antennas are far better than anything else Motorola has ever sold!

Great phone; great price!. This phone is really nice! The picture quality is great and it's very fast. The battery life is not as good as i thought it would be, but i had the LG XCharge before this one and the battery in that was no joke. So, to many people, this battery is probably amazing. My knowledge of how great batteries *can* be made is making this a biased review, i think. Again, I'm sure most would be pleased. I'd definitely recommend this phone, if you're used to this price-range of phones. I'm a fan smile

3 day battery is a lot of hooie.. Just got this a few days ago. Found it difficult to navigate compared to my last couple of phones. Battery seems to be a good legitimate 36 hr battery. Never a 3 day. Operates fast. If there are apps open when a call comes in it can be challenging to get to the phone app in time. Guess its a pretty steep learning curve.

Battery is huge disappointment. I bought this phone for the battery. It had great reviews, saying two or three days of battery usage. Totally NOT true. Gives me exactly 12 hours with a 100% charge. Also it said it had a there finger screenshot, also not true. Very disappointed. This is the second phone I've bought from Amazon. Guess I m getting ready to go back to Best Buys.

Decent phone all around, battery life NOT as good as expected.. Hi there, I bought this phone in anticipation of Motorola G7 Power's OUTSTANDING battery life. While the stock android experience is silky smooth and fluid, the battery life is not nearly as good as the Legendary Motorola G7 Power. It only lasts maybe 1 whole day after heavy use. G7 Power could probably last 3 days with 3 full days of use. Get your battery game back Motorola! We want BATTERY LIFE!
Great so far.. Battery lasts days. Works great.

Battery lasts 3+ days. Purchased for my fiance to replace her old LG K20 plus from 4 or 5 years ago. Main selling point: the battery. Lasted her 6 days on a full charge. She only uses it for text, facebook messenger, and snapchat. Can't speak for the face recognition software because she only uses fingerprint. That works flawlessly.
Battery. Good battery

Battery. The battery life is extraordinary. It doesn't last 3 days, but then again it depends how much you use the phone. The battery last me about a day and a half, so still better than any other phone I've had.

5-6 day battery life for me!. I haven't learned/used probably 1/2 of the features but am totally impressed with the battery life but I do use my laptop when I'm home which I'm sure allows my phone battery to last longer but it works for me!
Fast, Smooth, Sleek, with Great Battery Life.. I am so satisfied with my Moto. It's fast, smooth, sleek, and has a great battery life.

Great phone. No message light.. I love this phone... Battery last a long time. It took me a while to figure out if it has a back button. Yes it does... I wish it had a message light. If it does I haven't found it. Than it would be about perfect. Haven't used the camera enough to review
Long life battery.. This phone's battery does last 3 days. I use it all the time and I have never run out of battery time till it's time to charge it up. It's an excellent phone for the price.

Old or Used battery?. The phone is good for the price. I bought this phone to replace my old galaxy Note 8. The only issue is that the battery health is at 90%. Only been a month since I bought it, and I tested the battery health a couple of times. Should be higher since I bought this as new. So I'm worried that the battery wear will affect me faster in fewer years.
Moto g power battery life insane and very smooth -value king-. Pros: battery life, its fast, its smooth, very easy to use, light, fast Cons: camera is okay
Great battery. Battery lasts 3 days on one charge. Amazing!

Good choice. , it was a big debate between this and the LG Stylo six, I have loved the LG Stylo 3, 4 and 5 but once reading reviews I went with this phone. The screen is the same size but it is much easier to hold in your hand, has a great battery life, fast processor and great camera.
Easy to operate. Battery life lasted as advertised

A good phone but the battery life not as expected. Overall the Moto G Power is a good phone, especially considering the price. It looks very nice, feels solid in hand and takes decent pictures. However, I'm disappointed in the battery life which was the biggest selling point for me. After reading so many positive reviews regarding the 5,000mAh battery life, I was really looking forward to not having to charge my phone in the middle of the day. Unfortunately, I still have to charge my phone about 9 hours after I wake up which is nowhere close to the advertised 3 day charge. This is with moderate use such as browsing Facebook, listening to a podcast, watching a few short videos on YouTube, web searches and texting. I rarely make calls and I leave wifi and hotspot off. I only have Bluetooth on.

Power giant. I heavily use my mobile phone. The battery lasts me a good 2 days! By far the best phone I had in terms of battery life. Great display. Only con is that the camera is grainy at night. Back camera is good during the day.

Glad I went with it. I read a ton of reviews, on Amazon and other retailers, as well as PC Mag and Consumer Reports, and they all preferred this 2020 model over the 2021 model. I'm satisfied with my choice. The battery life is amazing. Blows my old phone (Moto G6) away! The only sacrifice you have to make is it's significantly heavier and the phone is bigger than I'd ideally want. So if you have weak joints in your hands or wrists, this might not be comfortable to hold a long time.

Mediocre phone, subpar battery life. I don't understand the reviews for this phone, but having relied on them myself, I feel I should provide mine. This phone is mediocre at best. Operation is slow and frequently stutters or stops, some of the Motorola features are interesting but most are gimmicky and don't work that well, and above all else the battery sucks. I've never made it through a day with this phone without recharging. It's clearly a budget phone but there are other budget options with much better operation, much better battery life, and much less annoyance.

Great Battery Life and not much bloatware. First Unlocked Phone I have ever purchased will definitely never buy a locked one again Loved the battery time's and not much bloatware to speak of my only complaint is that it comes with a 10 watt charger when it is capable of Motorola TurboPower charging so definitely upgrade the charger you won't regret it. There are reviews out there that say it doesn't have TurboPower Charging but it definitely doe's.

Battery does not last. This is my third Moto since 2016, and I've liked them all. Every feature it has works well, even the facial recognition (which still kind of freaks me out, hence the 3 stars for that). I'm not thrilled with the battery life. It might just be my perception, yet I feel that the battery drains very quickly. At least with the turbo charger it charges quickly. Overall, I'm pretty happy with the phone, and I'm glad I got it on sale for $150 because I don't think it's worth the $250 pricetag.

Well exceeded my expectations. It's like they designed this product for me... I don't need a phone that has the latest and greatest, I just wanted a long battery life and a good camera. Check, check. I used it for 6 hours to track a bike ride using the GPS and it still had 82% battery life left. That's incredible.

Works well, haven't used the face recognition or fingerprint reader because I don't care.. Battery life is good so far, gesture controls take getting used to but are useful once learned, Android 10 works well, has a functioning headphone jack, amazing main camera, good selfie camera, rarely slows down even if I try to slow it down, activating phone is as simple as it should be, no problems so far. Overall: 10/10 Review subject to change if the phone slows down, assuming I remember to change the review if/when that happens.

Battery life is horrible. Even brand new, battery life is horrible, plus, my sd card became dislodged when I inserted the tray, and I had to wind up returning the phone for replacement and wound up having to give up my sd card which had a LOT of pictures and music on it . The battery does not even last a whole day if you spend a couple of hours a day surfing facebook or playing a game. The only upside is the exchange went very easily. I wish I would have paid attention to the reviews that talked about the battery life or the sd card, as what has happened to me are NOT isolated incidents. I would have rather paid a bit more ( 50+) and not had to deal with any of this.

Meets battery life expectations.. For me, the most important thing was battery life and so far this phone is living up to the claims. I am consistently getting slightly more than 72 hours of life out of each charge. That includes reading mail and news throughout the day, doing a bit of GPS navigation, making a few short calls and doing a few text conversations. That is also without shutting it off at night or putting it in airplane mode. I wanted this for multi-day camping trips with the confidence that I would always have access to phone and data so long as I had a signal and GPS even when I don't. I carry a 10,000 mAh backup battery and so should be able to get up to 9 days of life easy out of this thing without plugging into a wall or a vehicle.
She leaves it on 24/7 and battery lasts about 3 weeks, before recharging. Be sure to use a good case and screen protector and you should never have a problem. CASE CLOSED!

Still Going. Had this phone longer than any in my life because I still get 2 days out of the battery. Spend a considerable amount of time on it too. Writing this review because I mindlessly started shopping for a new phone and realized I don't need one. Next year. Will get another motorola if they keep making them like this. Only $200 too.

Yes the stylus isn't as big as the S Pen, and doesn't have all the bells and whistles, but you aren't paying for those. I am not going to go into a major review of this phone as you can scan YouTube to find many videos that will cover all your needs. The one major plus for the Moto G Stylus is the battery. You can go all day or even 2 days or more on one charge, depending on the usage. The note 10, that battery barely lasts one whole day.

Good screen, finicky fingerprint reader, great battery standby time, good build quality, avg cams.... This is a good upgrade choice if battery capacity is your concern yet still managing to keep good price per performance. While its peers with similar specifications may have better cameras and performance boosts, the Moto G Power (2020) however is fairly feature-rich, inside is a larger-than-average 5,000mAh battery with good battery life for at least a day of medium-heavy use, 2 days of light-medium usage, and 3+ with light usage including standby times, which greatly reduces power consumption when the phone isn't being used in the moment, with great band support/carrier coverage and LTE speeds, a decent IPS panel with neutral color tone, dual-band (2.4ghz/5.8ghz) wifi, bluetooth 5.0, 4gb ram, 64gb internal storage for apps and other content with 512gb SD upgrade support, decent SoC performance with lag sometimes being an issue, great charging time from half capacity, and all of the necessary sensors for application support.

Hello Moto. Review by 43 year old American male. I needed a new cell phone that has a few specific features. Long battery life, a current barebones Android OS, and water resistancy. The battery life in the Moto G Power is beyond excellent... it goes and goes for days. It came out of the box undamaged and well packaged with all needed accessories included. It has basic Android 10 (with the May update running perfect) and without any extra crapps installed besides a few Motorola necessities that make operation simple. I don't have a car... but I ride a Harley-Davidson everywhere, the other day I had the Moto G Power mounted to my handlebars during a rainstorm and the phone still works perfect.

This phone is not as great as the reviews indicate.. Battery life is about half of what they claim! Of all the ZTE, Samsung and LE phones I have had, this Motorola is the toughest to learn how to use. Warning, you'll be "swiping" the screen more than you planned on. Now that I have been using this phone for a few weeks, I know I would NOT have bought it, if I would have known how it operates. I think from now on I will stick with Samsung phones.
Great battery life!. I think it’s great. I love the fingerprint reader!

Can't get the latest stuff now because we have a big family. That phone finally started acting weird - long story, I decided to look at something else with good battery. Back in the day, Motorola was known for good phones, this has great reviews, a little concerned about the price being that low. Thought I saw that they didn't use gorilla Glass, but I've had good luck with screens over the years for the most part. So I give it a try. For comparison, my Galaxy S7 battery was pretty good compared to other S7 battery life experiences in the family. I got in the habit of always closing all the apps. Medium use I could probably make it through the day without charging and it might go into power save at the end, so I eventually would try to keep it plugged in when not in use.

A battery champ. A good reliable phone with a good battery during my months with it has read my finger print very well, moto actions are really nice for a quick flashlight and few other actions stand out that help make it a need on other phones. However I do want to comment and alert of one during the moto actions, they have a peek display and its nice however it seems to go off even when your not looking at it so not sure if seeing something with eyes or something that grabs it attenion other then that all in all good phone.

Battery not 3 days. Got the phone about a week ago. Was excited about the battery life and the price. It's a nice phone. Had a Samsung before and I'd say it's equivalent, including the battery life. It does not last three days. I use my phone often but I'd say the battery lasts just as long as my Samsung 8 did so that's my only disappointment. Can't tell ya the stand by time. Who let's their phone stand by without use?!
battery life. I've had a lot of cell phones but this one has a great battery. I use it all day and it will only be down to 80%. I don't like all of the features but the battery life makes up for them
Good value. Only have it for one day but so far it’s doing great. Feels smooth, sharp, and good battery.

Better than my Moto G6. I'm surprised at how great this phone is for the money. Some of the negatives I've read in the reviews are rectified in the settings. Like the colors are not muted but can pop if you said it correctly. Another review claims they are missing the home and back buttons on the bottom but there's a setting to reinstate that. And so on. So far I haven't had any problems having a few apps open at the same time. The battery life is so so, I have to charge about once a day, but I'm on my phone constantly. The phone is slippery. Get a case immediately! All in all I'm thrilled with this phone. It's snappy and sexy looking, and feels well built. Mind you, I've never had an expensive phone so I have no comparison in that area.

Not user friendly. I chose this phone because it had great reviews for it's camera and it's battery life. My frustration is with the inability to store and access the pictures I take on the phone. It will not allow you to store pictures to an sd card and you can't access the photos from the DCIM file. I do not want to store my pictures on Google, but that seems to be the only option. Battery life is not much use if you can't use the phone for anything more than texting, calls, and web searches. I had a Samsung Galaxy phone before this and was frustrated with the short battery life, but honestly, it was so much easier to navigate that I will be returning to Samsung.

Great Battery Life. I love this phone. I normally get 3 full days of life from the battery. Processor is good, I can fly my drone with it, though the case is a bit large to fit in the clamp. Takes a bit of getting used to some of the movements, but I'm quite happy with the Moto G Power (2021)
Good battery life. I bought this to my mom, she loves it. Usually at the end of the day her past phones are almost dying but this has not shown any of this in the months that she has owned it.

Save for a better phone. This review is based on my experience with this phone: I bought this phone in August. As of this review, it is the first week of November, and this phone is already malfunctioning. The phone app is jamming/not dialing as it should, and the touchscreen doesn't respond as needed when using the phone app AND other apps. The phone hangs up when dialing and in some instances DURING the call, and the option for the keypad disappears during the calls. Hopefully, I will not need to dial 911 in a hurry. It also appears that the processing is delayed or like the phone is "thinking" and "lagging". The perks are that the battery life is incredible, and the camera is pretty good for the price point, and the phone is lightweight.

Best Battery Life EVER. I bought this phone for my Mother. She's always out running around and her old phone just couldn't keep up. She also is constantly taking video and pictures of my little Nephew. Her old phone would commonly be out of juice before the event she was documenting was finished, such as a trip to the Zoo etc. She'd often text me and inform me she was turning off her phone to conserve power. I thought this was unacceptable, she might need her phone for an important incoming call, or need to make an emergency outgoing call and with a dead battery this was a risk. So I set out to find a phone that could keep up with her. I found this Moto G Power and after watching many many reviews I decided to try it out.
Good battery life. Phone serves my purpose. Good battery life.

Battery life 100. BATTERY LIFE YO. I bought this specifically for the long lasting battery. After an ice storm last winter and being out of power for a week I realized how trash my old phones battery was, it wouldn't even last a day. Now I can forget to plug in my phone at night and still be on 70% the next day. I like the expandable storage, bought a sim card for it. Other specs are mediocre but those things weren't priority for me. I had an LGV30 before this and the ram, camera quality were pretty much equivalent even though V30 was a few years old at this point.
Battery does last 2 days. Battery does not last 2 days

Battery = Selling Point, slight lack in responsiveness.. Phone lasts 4 days easily without charging if you aren't constantly using it. If you are always on your phone, then I'd say 2 days easily. Love this thing. Purchased it in 8/2020 and had a Google Pixel 2 before. Though I love this phone, there is a slight decrease in processing power it seems compared to the Pixel 2. It's a little slower when opening apps but for the price, who cares. Camera is great, speaker is loud, screen is crystal clear, and the phone is actually pretty thin. I can say I'm a happy customer.
Battery life. I use a lot of apps like Kindle and my battery lasts for 2 days or more after a full charge.
